_comment: Single source of truth for code metric limits (FR-QG-16, E-15). Values are assumptions until measured (`dup.maxPercent` 1.65 is the start value measured with jscpd on 2026-10-06, assumption, ratcheted down to the 1 % target, read by tools/check/quality/duplicates/check-dup.mjs; `crap.max` 450 is the Tombola start value, assumption; read by tools/check/quality/check-crap.mjs). Read by eslint.config.js; per-area overrides are merged over `default`.

layoutShift._comment: US-QS-14, DS-52 (issue 1697): the cumulative layout shift of a cold load (one-screen project, judge.shift.ts) per route and layer at 360x640, 390x844 and 1280x800. A starting value (assumption), not measured: layout-shift-baseline.json lists the loads above 0.08, and a listed load may get worse by at most 0.02. blocking false: the check reports its findings and does not fail the run, until the R1 ticket #1729 "deterministic shift check" makes the measure deterministic (the spread between identical CI runs is up to 0.244) and sets blocking to true (owner decision 2026-11-08). Only tightened; a loosening needs a reason in its PR (US-QG-07).

lighthouse._comment: QG-U1 / FR-QG-09 (issue 1136): medians of 3 mobile Lighthouse runs on the start page must stay within these limits, read by tools/check/release/check-lighthouse-summary.mjs. Starting values (assumption) with slack over the CI measurement of 2026-11-02 (docs/records/test-logs/issue-1136-lighthouse-baseline.md: performance 93, accessibility 100, best practices 96, SEO 82, LCP 2.74-2.79 s, TBT 0-4 ms, CLS 0.000); TBT 200 ms and CLS 0.1 are the 'good' limits of web.dev. Only tightened; a loosening needs a reason in its PR (US-QG-07).

perf._comment: NFR-12 / FR-QG-09 (issue 1250): budgets of the nightly load measurement (packages/api/perf/load/measure.ts, every GET route at `size` specimens, in process against PostgreSQL 18 on a GitHub runner), read by packages/api/perf/load/budget-report.ts. Starting values (assumption) from ONE CI run (nightly 42079900165 on 2026-11-05, AMD EPYC 7763, 4 cores, 20 timed runs per route): the default holds every ordinary route with slack, a route gets its own budget at 1.5x its measured value (rounded up to 5) where that is above the default. Report only (owner decision 2026-11-05): `blocking` is switched on by the owner through its own gate PR after about two weeks of nightly numbers (issue 1250).
